correctness.rationale: For Cr_n with chosen index sets P,Q, define d_i=1_P(i)-1_Q(i). Literal closed-neighborhood tests reduce to q+d_i>=k and p-d_i>=k for every i; the only one-sided exceptions are k=1, S=A/B. Otherwise p,q>=k and p=k forces P⊆Q, q=k forces Q⊆P. Binomial enumeration partitions interior and exact boundaries with the diagonal counted once, giving stated bivariate F_{n,k} and D_{×k}, minimum 2k and binom(n,k) minima. Independent direct neighborhood set enumeration for n=3..7 checked all k and every bivariate coefficient; proof is all n>=3.
